title: Mazatzal trail graph
description: Curated graph of junctions and named legs. Generated by the curation tool; see docs/trail-graph-schema.md. Condition observations live in a separate file and are never regenerated.

retired.description: Tombstones for ids withdrawn from use, so already-shared route URLs can be repaired rather than silently changing meaning. Never reissue a retired id.

id.description: Assigned once by the curation tool from the next free code; never derived from geometry or ordering. Each entity type has its own id space.

code.description: Forest Service trail number or road number, where one exists.

node.description: A junction or trailhead. Nodes are the connectivity structure and are the only thing that splits a segment.

segment.description: A named leg of tread between two nodes. Geometry runs from -> to; the reverse direction swaps gain_ft and loss_ft.

name.description: Shown in the builder, so it must read as a place: 'Davenport Trailhead to Sheep Creek Junction'.

trails.description: Parent trails in display precedence. trails[0] is the local name a hiker reads off the sign; long-distance overlays follow. Multiple entries where named trails share tread.

gain_ft.description: Gain travelling from -> to. Computed by simplifying the elevation profile first, then summing, so the value is direction-symmetric and the reverse is exactly loss_ft.

geometry.description: Path to this segment's full-resolution geometry, fetched only at export time. Point data never appears inline.

sources.description: The recorded tracks this leg was derived from. Walked-it-myself provenance is the point of the project and must survive into the graph.

feature.description: A point of interest. Features do NOT split segments; they ride along one at a position, which is what a later split-here action resolves to.

on.description: Derived at build time by projecting lat/lon onto a segment. Coordinates are the authored truth; this projection is a convenience and is recomputed whenever geometry changes.

at.description: Derived. Fraction along the segment's geometry, from its `from` end.

superseded_by.description: Where the retired id's ground went, so a stale route URL can be repaired instead of dropped.
